rows.text: Citing Article 121-7 (parts four and five) and Article 121-8 of the Constitution, Decree No. 1398 establishes that assignments to the Vice-President of the Russian Federation to exercise particular powers of the President, and decisions on his replacing the President in his absence, are made by decree or order of the President, and that the Vice-President's exercise of such powers outside that procedure is an appropriation of the President's powers, unlawful and invalid under Article 121-3. It is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', 18 сентября 1993 года, № 1398.
